description: Zero SMP performance tuning: Grassier Grass radius 80, rain particle de-duplication (Particular rain ripples and Immersive Winds splashes, which ParticleRain already draws), remove Cull Leaves (already disabled; MoreCulling culls leaves) and MidnightLib, its only user. Corgilib, Data Anchor and Player Animation Lib stay: the Zero SMP server runs them (the first two are required for joining; Player Animation Lib is unproven without a join test and saves nothing). Reviewed: ModernFix opt-ins, ParticleRain's particle cap and Particular's drip ripples stay at their defaults.
